changes_ab.instructions: Does document A change part of what document B specifies?

criteria.false: A leaves what B specifies as it is: it adds to it, depends on it, records something about it, or is about something else
criteria.true: A revises, renames, re-homes or overrides some of the work, design or decision in B, so that part of B is out of date while the rest may still hold

changes_ba.instructions: Does document B change part of what document A specifies?

criteria.false: B leaves what A specifies as it is: it adds to it, depends on it, records something about it, or is about something else
criteria.true: B revises, renames, re-homes or overrides some of the work, design or decision in A, so that part of A is out of date while the rest may still hold

records_ab.instructions: Is document A an account of something that happened involving what document B describes?

criteria.false: A is itself a design, plan or reference rather than an account of events, or the events it reports concern something else
criteria.true: A reports an incident, outage, investigation, review, meeting, conversation or decision about the system, feature or plan that B describes

records_ba.instructions: Is document B an account of something that happened involving what document A describes?

criteria.false: B is itself a design, plan or reference rather than an account of events, or the events it reports concern something else
criteria.true: B reports an incident, outage, investigation, review, meeting, conversation or decision about the system, feature or plan that A describes

related.instructions: Are document A and document B about the same piece of work, so that a reader of one would want to know about the other?

criteria.false: they share vocabulary or a broad area only; a reader of one would gain nothing from the other
criteria.true: they concern the same feature, system, plan, incident or decision: one builds on, revises, records or accompanies the other

replaces_ab.instructions: Does document A replace document B as a whole?

criteria.false: B still holds at least in part: A changes only some of it, adds to it, or is about something else
criteria.true: A is the current account of everything B covered, so B as a whole is no longer the account to follow

replaces_ba.instructions: Does document B replace document A as a whole?

criteria.false: A still holds at least in part: B changes only some of it, adds to it, or is about something else
criteria.true: B is the current account of everything A covered, so A as a whole is no longer the account to follow
